## Problem to solve

What workflow, limitation, or friction are you running into?

## Proposed change

What would you like StageFlow to do differently?

## Why this matters

Explain who benefits and how this would improve scanning, triage, CI, or onboarding.

## Constraints or alternatives considered

List any workarounds, rejected ideas, or constraints that shape the request.

## Additional context

Add mockups, examples, related issues, or prior art if it helps.
